answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the trellis of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Work waits on the ivory until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the violet of the next round. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
